Wide own-date labels in the document's head (Date seen, Case date, Exam date, Date performed, Day of procedure, and the other forms of _WIDE_DATE_LABEL) and the worded date-of-service field of D2 ('Service date logged for this case: ...') only ever ASK or NARROW, and are never sent: (a) the installed reading sends X and such a label states Y: the date is asked and only X is a member's answer (the narrow release's question, read by charge_date_problem / charge_date_own / charge_question_day, so every reader still reads X); (b) the installed reading already asks with evidence: unchanged; (c) it asks with no evidence at all (any member date taken): the labels become that evidence - one value only when a closing-role line states the same day, several values as a conflict of those values - so only dates the document states are taken. Hardening: no wide or worded label is read when sections.around_procedure_title matches (the installed fact stands); corroboration only from closing-role lines among the last 8 non-empty lines, never from a consent, order, request, booking/scheduling or call/phone line. Built so that the installed candidates - and so the installed fact - are computed exactly as installed (the wide candidates are read beside them, never among them: the prototype's joint pass let _after_another_header keep an addendum's own label 'own' when a wide label stood in the head, a possible NEW-SEND), and every other text reads byte-identically.

narrows_only_when: (1) the label's day is the AUTHOR'S OWN sign-off day: a closing-role line of the note's closing region that signs, e-signs, authenticates or finalizes the note (a dictation word beside such a verb does not disqualify it) - never a co-signature or countersignature, a transcription line, or a consent, order, request, booking, scheduling or call line; an attestation counts as the author's own sign-off ONLY when it names the performer a head field names (proceduralist, endoscopist, operator, performing physician, gastroenterologist, colonoscopist, surgeon, attending, physician, provider, seen by, author): h4-06's 'Attested:' line is its colonoscopist's own sign-off, B3's attestation by an unnamed signer is not

(3) the closing region is the note's own: its last 8 non-empty lines and never any line of the head (a short document whose head is all of it narrows nothing; the label's own line is the head's); no addendum line after the head; no line anywhere announcing copied, pasted, attached, imported, scanned, faxed, forwarded or excerpted text; the sign-off line not under a heading-like line naming another occurrence's record (sections.under_another_occurrence)

(4) the document is not around a procedure under the BROADENED detection: sections.around_procedure_title, or among the first 12 non-empty lines a title-like line or a flattened line's cell (at most 160 characters, no field value, no closing sentence punctuation) or a kind field ('Note type:', 'Encounter type:', 'Visit type:', 'Type of visit:', 'Encounter:', 'Visit:', 'Note:', ...) whose words name a booking or scheduling, pre-anything procedural (pre-procedure, pre op, pre-admission, pre-colonoscopy, ...), prep, a telephone, phone or call, a message, an appointment, a reminder, instructions, a consent, education, a handout, correspondence, a letter, a review, an outside record, nursing or a nurse, an assessment, triage, a portal, e-mail, fax, a refill, a referral, a request, an order, a cancellation, a no-show, intake, telehealth, telemedicine, a virtual or video visit

amendment_20261101_integration.rule: STRONG-HEAD HOLD. When the document's head is a procedure report's own head - detect.todays_procedure_report, the strong head PI+PE's cycle 1 reads for E1 (an own-date field, a proceduralist field and a sedation field as labelled fields, one own date, no review or result title), imported and never copied - and that own-date field gives exactly one date, a member's date answer that DIFFERS from it is HELD (asked): never narrowed, never taken, never sent. The question quotes the head's own-date line and any other line of the document that states a service date for the same case (h4-03's case-room ledger, 'Service date logged for this case: 10/08/2026'). It only moves TAKEN -> HELD; NEW-SEND and NEW-TAKE stay 0
reading: the head's one date is the one detect._gi4_head reads (the predicate's own); its own-date fields are the head lines _gi4_head reads, with the same labels and dates (SERVICE_DATE or WIDE_SERVICE_DATE at a line's start after its markdown lead, detect._GI4_MARKUP, among its first sections.PROCEDURE_HEAD_LINES non-empty lines). 'Gives exactly one date': no other date-shaped text (_PD_OTHER_DATE) in the field, up to its field break or its line's end

a note written AROUND a procedure is no procedure report's own head, whatever fields it carries: under rule (c)'s broadened detection (_pd_around_procedure: titles, cells, kind fields) or stating a call, a phone contact or a message as an event (_PD_CALL_PHRASE), the hold does not read it. Its 'Day of procedure' is the planned procedure's, and the plan's must-hold F7 binds: the call's and the booking's own day stay a member's answer. Hold direction only: where the hold does not read, the reading without it stands (never a new take or send). Measured: none of the texts the hold moves is such a note

only an answer merge_user_values would TAKE is held: a post-step on its 'user' result for service_date, so an answer it holds keeps its own hold and note, and the head's own day is taken only where it was taken before

the 'none' state is unchanged: the fact's origin, value and evidence, the request, and every reader's date (service_date_of, charge_question_day). Where the date is asked and an answer of another day would be taken (_takes_another_day: merge_user_values' branches, in its order), the fact's NOTE says so: HEAD_DATE_NOTE replaces a note no reader reads (h4-03's WIDE_DATE_QUOTE_NOTE said 'a member's date is taken', false under the hold); the narrow release's and rule (a)'s question keeps its note, which charge_date_problem reads, and _HEAD_CHARGE_NOTE follows it, naming no document line so that the question's own markers stay its last; a documented conflict's note is its values (documented_values) and stays as made

a sent date the strong head contradicts (the installed reading sends X and the head gives another day): a member's answer X is held as the rule says, and the 'none' state still sends X (the rule moves no send). Measured: no such text among the 2,453 strong heads of the H2 corpus; each of their 1,292 sent dates equals its head's
